```python
def generate_palindrome(n):
    half = n // 2
    palindrome = ''.join(str(i) for i in range(1, half + 1)) + str(half)
    
    if n % 2 == 0:
        reverse_half = palindrome[:half][::-1]
    else:
        reverse_half = palindrome[:half - 1][::-1]

    full_palindrome = palindrome + reverse_half
    return full_palindrome

# Generate a palindrome of length 5 (for demonstration purposes)
palindrome_5 = generate_palindrome(5)
print(palindrome_5)  # Output: "12321"
```
